source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 3 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、互联网/上网安全/网购/社交媒体主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.meaning_cn: 通道;(使用、查阅的)机会;进入;获取
words.example_en: Everyone should have access to the Internet and new technology.
words.example_cn: 每个人都应该能接触到互联网和新技术。

words.example_en: Never share the password of your online account with strangers.
words.example_cn: 绝不要把你网上账户的密码告诉陌生人。

words.example_en: The author of the blog gives tips on how to stay safe online.
words.example_cn: 这篇博客的作者给出了如何安全上网的建议。

words.example_en: I downloaded the software to help my phone battery last longer.
words.example_cn: 我下载了这个软件来让我的手机电池更耐用。

words.example_en: One of the greatest benefits of the Internet is connecting people.
words.example_cn: 互联网最大的好处之一是把人们联系起来。

words.example_en: Today I want to blog about how to stay safe online.
words.example_cn: 今天我想写篇博客谈谈如何安全上网。

words.example_en: Many years as a blogger have taught me a thing or two about the Internet.
words.example_cn: 多年的博主经历让我对互联网懂得了一些门道。

words.example_en: Have you pressed the button yet to copy the file?
words.example_cn: 你按按钮复制文件了吗?

words.example_en: We no longer have to carry cash around when we go shopping online.
words.example_cn: 我们网购时不再需要随身带现金了。

words.example_en: Her next goal is to start a charity website to raise money for children.
words.example_cn: 她下一个目标是创建一个慈善网站为孩子们筹钱。

words.example_en: I especially like to chat with my friends and family online.
words.example_cn: 我特别喜欢在网上和朋友家人聊天。

words.example_en: Don't click on anything that makes you feel uncomfortable.
words.example_cn: 不要点击任何让你感到不舒服的东西。

words.example_en: For the past few years, Wuzhen has hosted the World Internet Conference.
words.example_cn: 过去几年里,乌镇主办了世界互联网大会。

words.example_en: Have you confirmed the Wi-Fi password?
words.example_cn: 你确认过 Wi-Fi 密码了吗?

words.example_en: The Internet has made our lives more convenient.
words.example_cn: 互联网让我们的生活更方便了。

words.phrase_en: become a target for a cyberbully
words.example_en: Be polite so that you don't become a target for a troll or cyberbully.
words.example_cn: 要有礼貌,这样你才不会成为喷子或网霸的目标。

words.example_en: We can get the most updated information from large databases.
words.example_cn: 我们能从大型数据库中获取最新的信息。

words.example_en: A good blog post should define new words for its readers.
words.example_cn: 一篇好的博文应该为读者解释新词。

words.example_en: Laura needs an app that will help her get discounts when shopping.
words.example_cn: 劳拉需要一个能在购物时帮她拿折扣的应用。

words.example_en: The Internet can remove the distance that exists between people.
words.example_cn: 互联网能消除人与人之间的距离。

words.example_en: A cyberbully may post embarrassing photos about other people.
words.example_cn: 网霸可能会发布有关他人的难堪照片。

words.example_en: A search engine is a tool that helps you find what you're looking for.
words.example_cn: 搜索引擎是一种帮你找到所需内容的工具。

words.example_en: Trolls often use several false names so that they can stay on a site.
words.example_cn: 喷子常用好几个假名以便留在网站上。

words.example_en: Use a website that you are familiar with when shopping online.
words.example_cn: 网购时使用你熟悉的网站。

words.example_en: Click the button to copy the file to your computer.
words.example_cn: 点击按钮把文件复制到你的电脑上。

words.example_en: A kind of new PC has been built with more functions.
words.example_cn: 一种功能更多的新电脑已被造出来了。

words.example_en: The author provides clear guidelines for staying safe online.
words.example_cn: 作者提供了安全上网的明确准则。

words.example_en: Someone might use the information to steal your identity online.
words.example_cn: 有人可能会用这些信息在网上盗用你的身份。

words.example_en: She was so inspired by the people she met online that she started a club.
words.example_cn: 她受网上结识的人鼓舞,以至于创办了一个俱乐部。

words.example_en: People's lives have been changed by online communities and social networks.
words.example_cn: 人们的生活被网络社区和社交网络改变了。

words.example_en: A cyberbully often writes mean things directed at particular people.
words.example_cn: 网霸常写针对特定人的刻薄话。

words.example_en: You get a message whenever someone presses the update button.
words.example_cn: 每当有人按下更新按钮,你就会收到一条消息。

words.example_en: Protect your privacy and don't give out your address or phone number.
words.example_cn: 保护好你的隐私,不要透露你的地址或电话号码。

words.example_en: Wuzhen is a small waterside town in Zhejiang Province.
words.example_cn: 乌镇是浙江省一个小小的水乡。

words.example_en: Residents here can go online as easily as in large modern cities.
words.example_cn: 这里的居民能像大城市里一样轻松地上网。

words.example_en: Being online is no excuse for being rude to others.
words.example_cn: 上网不是对别人无礼的借口。

words.example_en: We can download software, documents, and images whenever we need them.
words.example_cn: 我们需要时随时都能下载软件、文档和图片。

words.meaning_cn: 流播(在线播放音视频);流出;小河
words.example_en: Plus they can stream movies and music at high speeds.
words.example_cn: 而且他们能高速流播电影和音乐。

words.example_en: She discovered that surfing the Internet could help her feel less lonely.
words.example_cn: 她发现上网浏览能帮她减少孤独感。

words.meaning_cn: 目标;对象;把……作为攻击目标
words.example_en: You don't want to become a target for a troll or cyberbully.
words.example_cn: 你不会想成为喷子或网霸的攻击目标。

words.example_en: Identity theft is a common and serious problem on the Internet.
words.example_cn: 身份盗窃是互联网上一个常见而严重的问题。

words.example_en: Do you have any tips for how to surf the Internet safely?
words.example_cn: 你有没有安全上网的小窍门?

words.example_en: When you go through tough times, you meet others facing similar challenges.
words.example_cn: 当你度过艰难时期时,会遇到面临类似挑战的人。

words.meaning_cn: 发挑衅帖子的人;恶意挑衅的帖子
words.example_en: A troll is a person who posts comments in order to stir up trouble online.
words.example_cn: 喷子是那种为了在网上惹是生非而发帖的人。

words.example_en: You get a message whenever there has been an update.
words.example_cn: 每当有更新时,你就会收到一条消息。

words.example_en: The girl was very upset after she was made fun of online.
words.example_cn: 那个女孩在网上被取笑后非常难过。

words.example_en: Have you confirmed the Wi-Fi password for the new network?
words.example_cn: 你确认过新网络的 Wi-Fi 密码了吗?

words.example_en: Has anyone made a comment about the online database yet?
words.example_cn: 有人对这个在线数据库发表评论了吗?
